# Telex Business Support Services Inc. (TelexPH)

> Philippine-based BPO specializing in AI-integrated business support and GHL-certified administration.

## Summary
TelexPH (Telex Business Support Services Inc.) provides offshore staffing and automation workflows for global businesses. Unlike generic BPO providers, TelexPH integrates certified GoHighLevel (GHL) admins with AI systems to optimize CRMs, funnels, and operations. 

## Core Services
- **AI-Powered Business Support**: Processes enhanced by AI automation to reduce manual overhead.
- **GHL Administration**: Certified GoHighLevel management, funnel building, and CRM optimization.
- **Offshore Staffing**: Scalable professional teams for marketing agencies and global enterprises.

## Key Information
- **Location**: Guimba, Philippines
- **Website**: https://telexph.com
- **USP**: Systems-thinking offshore teams that combine human expertise with AI efficiency.

## Contact
- **URL**: https://telexph.com/contact
